sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent intermediate is the exact upper/lower object membership created by that threshold, represented by each member top row, left column, and cell count; on this case the canonical threshold is 21.5 and yields group sizes 2 and 2.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Detect the four 8-connected colored objects, sort them by top row, derive the canonical row threshold as the mean of the first and last object top rows, and partition the objects into the two members above that threshold and the two members at or below it.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Consume those two groups, order the members inside each group by ascending cell count with left column as the tie-breaker, then copy their normalized crops into the four fixed 7x7 quadrant slots in upper-group then lower-group order.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B cannot choose its candidate members or output slots until Step A has produced the input-specific upper/lower partition. Replacing Step A with the canvas midpoint 15.0 puts all four objects in one group, changes the order consumed by Step B, and changes the protected-Racket final output.

report.summary: Built a native two-setting row-group ordering family without changing the approved production generator. The default is exact canonical program bytes; the alternate preserves the canonical input-derived row partition and orders members within each group by cell count. Retained qualification covers both settings on two seeds, four queries per episode, and a protected-Racket wrong-intermediate causal witness.
